production_metadata.production_description: The trureturning formalization campaign. Human direction selected the benchmark, campaign objective and submission identity; mathematical proof implementation used Codex CLI. Independent mathematical/source review passed with two Codex CLI seats and one GPT-6 Pro seat through the chrono-500 pool; the CLI tests seat freshly recompiled all seven candidate modules and the untouched official Solution. This is an attributed formalization of Giles Gardam's known counterexample, not a claim of a new mathematical counterexample. It builds on Gardam's paper (arXiv:2102.11818v2, sections 3.1–3.2) and pinned Mathlib APIs. The proof supplies a faithful two-sided normal-form equivalence for the exact PresentedGroup, torsion-freeness, explicit two-sided inverse identities, and group-ring support and transport arguments. It locally compiled with the benchmark's Lean 4.35.0-rc3 / Mathlib 5e0c4e5239cb0a2d86d68a884bf52cfd963fce22 pins, with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound in the printed transitive axiom closures. No manual human proof edits are reported. Allowed LeanPool Polylean related machinery was discovered separately after this candidate was produced; it is not imported by the submitted proof. Official comparator and nanoda acceptance are requested and not presumed from local compilation. No measured monetary-cost claim is made.
